items.t: Timing belt snaps and bends valves
items.job: Replace timing belt and repair cylinder head (bent valves)
items.note: Doing the belt before it breaks costs about $540–950.

items.t: Timing belt idler pulley breaks
items.job: Replace timing belt, idler pulley and tensioner
items.note: If the valves were damaged, head repair adds much more.

items.t: Burnt valves or cracked cylinder head
Engine stalls or dies while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace crankshaft sensor or control module
items.note: Cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Loses power, bucks or stalls
items.note: Cleaning the throttle body or a connector repair costs much less.

items.t: Misfire from failed ignition coil
Oil leak into spark plug wells
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals

items.t: Thermostat housing cracks and leaks coolant
Blown head gasket
items.note: A warped or cracked head adds machining or a new head.

items.t: A/C compressor fails
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and drier, evacuate and recharge

items.t: Front-end rattle or pop over bumps
items.job: Replace front sway bar links or control arm

items.t: Daytime running light module can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Rear seat belt can lock up (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Fuel line and fuse block crash fire risk (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Brake fluid can corrode ABS valve (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Key stuck or shifter will not leave Park
items.job: Repair shifter interlock or replace brake light switch

items.t: Turn signals stop working
Airbag light stays on
items.note: A passenger seat sensor costs more if that is the fault.

items.t: Check engine light for catalytic converter
items.job: Replace catalytic converter or oxygen sensor
items.note: Low end is an oxygen sensor; high end is a converter.

items.t: Wind noise from doors
items.job: Adjust door or glass and replace weatherstrip

items.t: Broken engine mount
